name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端：内置官方 dsh 运行时与 Node，终端用户无需安装 npm/node，完整复用官方 Web UI，并支持从 npm registry 自动更新运行时。
author: dsh-desktop contributors <maintainer@example.com>

scripts.dev: npm run sync:plugins && npm run build && electron .
scripts.stage: npm run stage:runtime && npm run stage:node && npm run link:runtime && npm run compress:runtime
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --linux --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --win --linux --x64
scripts.test:startup: npm run sync:plugins && npm run build && node scripts/test-startup.mjs && node scripts/test-startup-window.cjs
